mapper.update: lock table collect_interface_config, collect_protocol_config, device_satellite, telemetry_system_config, telemetry_parse_rule_config, processing_rule_config, calib_channel_config, calib_record, calib_record_detail, collect_interface_statistics, data_processing_statistics, dm_alarm_event, processed_telemetry_filter_selection, monitor_dashboard_widget in access exclusive mode
mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = current_schema() and table_name = 'processing_rule_config' and column_name = 'scope_key' )

WITH configuration_conflicts AS ( select cast(concat(concat('设备卫星重复：', cast(type as text)), concat('/', cast(code as text))) as text) as detail from device_satellite where is_deleted = 0 group by type, code having count(1) > 1 union all select cast(concat('校准公式重复：', cast(calibration_formula as text)) as text) as detail from calib_channel_config where is_deleted = 0 group by calibration_formula having count(1) > 1 union all select cast(concat(concat('组件键重复：用户', cast(user_id as text)), concat('/', cast(widget_key as text))) as text) as detail from monitor_dashboard_widget where 1 = 1 group by user_id, widget_key having count(1) > 1 union all select cast(concat(concat('参数勾选重复：设备', cast(device_satellite_id as text)), concat('/', cast(telemetry_code as text))) as text) as detail from processed_telemetry_filter_selection where 1 = 1 group by selection_type, target_id, device_satellite_id, telemetry_code having count(1) > 1 union all select cast(concat('采集统计窗口重复：接口', cast(interface_id as text)) as text) as detail from collect_interface_statistics where 1 = 1 group by interface_id, statistics_time having count(1) > 1 union all select cast(concat('处理统计窗口重复：接口', cast(interface_id as text)) as text) as detail from data_processing_statistics where 1 = 1 group by interface_id, statistics_time having count(1) > 1 ) select detail from configuration_conflicts order by detail limit 100
